rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for saying that something happens rarely or not often.

example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 siu2 jam2 gaa3 fe1

rows.note: Use this for the softer sense of not doing something much or not very often.

example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 do1 tai2 din6 si6

rows.note: Use this more formal alternative, especially in written or careful language.

example.traditional: 甚少有人喺呢度食早餐。
example.jyutping: sam6 siu2 jau5 jan4 hai2 ni1 dou6 sik6 zou2 caan1
